description: This file defines a custom exception class named DailyTPTTransactionAmountLimitExceededException, extending an abstract platform domain rule exception, used to indicate that a daily third-party transfer limit has been exceeded for a specific account.

classes.name: DailyTPTTransactionAmountLimitExceededException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the daily third-party transfer limit for an account has been exceeded.

methods.name: DailyTPTTransactionAmountLimitExceededException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific account information, constructing an error message.
